heroSubtitle: All 197 papers, with your place saved, your notes beside the text, and search across every paragraph.
ideasBody: The Urantia Papers discuss the universe, human history, and spiritual life. They were first published in 1955.
ideaScienceBody: Descriptions of the structure and organization of the universe.
ideaOriginsBody: An account of the origin and history of human civilization.
ideaSpiritBody: A view of science, philosophy, and religion as parts of one whole.
papersBody: The Urantia Papers are 197 papers, including the Foreword. They cover cosmology, human history, and the life and teachings of Jesus.
papersFoundationBody: first published them as The Urantia Book in 1955.
heroImageAlt: Celestial host writing the Urantia Papers
insightCreatorBody: Discover our Creator who set in motion a vast family of celestial beings dedicated to helping humanity grow and progress.
insightUniverseBody: Explore the intricate structure of our local universe and its relationship to the greater cosmos.
insightStoryBody: Uncover the fascinating history of our world, from the origins of human civilization to our modern global society.
insightJesusBody: Experience a unique perspective on the life and teachings of Jesus, revealing the human story behind the historical figure.
insightsNote: These topics represent the four major parts of the Urantia Papers.
developersLink: For Developers: Explore the Urantia Papers API
challengeHeading: The Challenge of Studying the Papers
challengeLead: Traditional study methods present several key challenges:
challengePages: 2,000+ pages of complex concepts make comprehension difficult
challengeProgress: Hard to track progress and locate specific passages
challengeAids: No integrated study aids for complex topics
modernBody: We've reimagined how these timeless teachings can be accessed and studied in the digital age, addressing traditional challenges with innovative solutions:
featureReadAnywhereBody: Access the papers on any device with our responsive platform and offline capabilities.
featureResume: Pick Up Where You Left Off
featureResumeBody: Continue reading exactly where you stopped last time, with automatic progress tracking across devices.
featureSearchBody: Easily find specific papers or passages with our powerful search functionality.
featureProgressBody: Track your reading journey with completion percentages for each paper, making learning engaging and motivating.
featureBookmarksBody: Save your favorite passages for quick reference and see how many others found them meaningful.
featureNotesBody: Create private notes on any passage to capture your thoughts and insights.
featureAudioLead: Listen to high-quality audio narration with text highlighting, or enjoy the full papers on
featureAiBody: Get instant explanations and reflection questions for complex passages through our AI companion.
featureCustomizeBody: Personalize your reading experience with adjustable font sizes and light/dark mode themes.
communityBody: Share a passage, and see which passages other readers marked.
communityShareBody: Share inspiring passages on social media or copy direct links to your favorite sections to discuss with friends.
communityPopularBody: See which passages resonate most with other readers. Discover how many others found specific teachings meaningful and impactful.
communityNotesBody: Share your insights on specific passages and engage in meaningful discussions with other readers about their interpretations.
communityMarketBody: Discover books, art, and other creative works inspired by these teachings. Share your own derivative works with the community.
